contexts.text: All the density of its cloud is thence.
The dense falsity from which is evil, and the dense evil from which is falsity.
This may be evident from the density of the sphere in which sensuous Spirits are, and from the purity of the sphere in which are the Angels of Heaven.
The density of falsity from evil. Signified.
The branch of a thick tree () = scientific truth. AC 9296:6.
The speech of the Angels of the lower Heaven appears as a bright cloud... in density and tenuity according to the quality of the truths.

Lo, I come to thee in the density of a cloud () = that it shall take place in a form in the highest degree natural... Density = what is obscure... What is Divine can only appear to such... as the density of a cloud. AC 8814.
The Lord must appear to such in a dense and heavy cloud. In the other life they are circumfused with a dense and black cloud, according to the quality and quantity of the falsities.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] The proprium of man... is nothing but dense evil. References.
How great is the density of the sphere...
Through a land of... dense shadow () = a state of falsity.
